question:

Logic followed here is: The series follows a pattern where the first and second letters of each term decrease by specific constant values in each step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/633525defa77865b80dc227338aff885bf3297722fe402808bd302588ff07f89.png]
